songs.title: Amazing Grace
songs.content:
Verse 1:
D             G        D
Amazing Grace, how sweet the sound,
                    A7
that saved a wretch like me
D             G        D
I once was lost, but now am found,
    Hm      A7       D
was blind, but now I see.

Verse 2:
D                 G        D
'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
                     A7
and grace my fears relieved.
D                G        D
How precious did that grace appear,
    Hm    A7       D
the hour I first believed.

Chorus:
G                D/F#
My chains are gone, I've been set free,
Em7              D
My God, my Savior has ransomed me.
G                D/F#
And like a flood His mercy reigns,
Em7        A7         D
Unending love, amazing grace.

Verse 3:
D                  G           D
When we've been there ten thousand years,
D                      A7
bright shining as the sun
D              G             D
We've no less days to sing God's praise
     Hm     A7       D
than when we first begun.

[G]Sung by f[Em]laming tongues [C]above;
Praise the [G]mount!  I'm fixed [D]upon it,
[D]Mount of [C]Thy re[D]deeming [G]love.

Verse 2:

Hither b[C]y Thy hel[D]p I'm come;[G]
[G]And I hope,[Em] by Thy good[D] pleasure,
[D]Safely to[C] arrive at[D] home. [G]
[G]Jesus sou[Em]ght me when a s[C]tranger,
[G]Wandering[Em] from the fold[C] of God;
He, to resc[G]ue me from danger,[D]
[D]Interpose[C]d His[D] precious[G] blood.

Verse 3:
Oh, to[G] grace how great a[D] debtor,
Daily[C] I'm cons[D]trained to [G]be!
[G]Let Thy [Em]goodness, like a[D] fetter,
Bind my[C] wand'ring [D]heart to [G]Thee.
